HOPE FOR HUMANITY

Restoring Dignity. Providing Hope. Changing Lives.

We serve people experiencing homelessness, poverty, hunger and social hardship through food relief, mobile soup kitchens, portable showers, clothing, hygiene assistance and community outreach.

OUR MISSION

Hope for Humanity provides practical humanitarian assistance while promoting dignity, compassion, opportunity, self-reliance and social inclusion.

Food Relief

Meals, food parcels and essential groceries for people and families in need.

Mobile Services

Soup kitchens and portable shower facilities that can reach different communities.

Community Outreach

Taking assistance directly to impoverished and underserved areas.

OUR PROGRAMMES

🍲 Mobile Soup Kitchens

🚿 Portable Showers

🚐 Vehicle & Outreach

WHO WE ARE

Hope for Humanity is a non-profit organisation established for the benefit of people experiencing homelessness, poverty, hunger and social hardship.

Our Vision

A society where every person has access to basic human necessities, dignity, compassion, opportunity and hope.

Our Mission

Practical humanitarian assistance through food relief, mobile soup kitchens, portable showers, clothing, hygiene assistance and outreach.

Our Values

Integrity, compassion, accountability, respect for human dignity and service without discrimination.

OUR HISTORY

This page is ready to become the permanent history of Hope for Humanity.

Our Foundation

Hope for Humanity was established to provide practical assistance to people experiencing homelessness, poverty, hunger and social hardship.

Our Growth

As the organisation develops, this timeline can record milestones, outreach locations, partnerships, campaigns, programme launches and major achievements.

Our Future

The organisation aims to build sustainable partnerships and funding so its programmes can reach increasing numbers of people in need.

Management Committee

The constitution provides for a Management Committee of not fewer than three persons.

  • Chairperson
  • Deputy Chairperson
  • Secretary
  • Treasurer
  • Additional Committee Members as required

Membership
